definitions.explanation: To acquire something by paying money. The basic verb for purchasing goods or services.

examples.japanese: どこで{買|か}いましたか。
{新|あたら}しいパソコンを{買|か}いたいです。
examples.english: I want to buy a new computer.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{買|か}う (buy X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state or repeated action. {買|か}っている = 'have bought' or 'buy regularly.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{本|ほん}を{買|か}う (buy a book)
・〜で{買|か}う (buy at ~)
・{買|か}い{物|もの} (shopping - noun)
・{買|か}い{物|もの}に{行|い}く (go shopping)

Opposite: {売|う}る (to sell).
